correctness.rationale: In each ordinary binary length group, the valid suffixes are tiled uniquely by 1 and 00. Sorting them splits them as 00L_(L−2) followed by 1L_(L−1), with one new gap G_L=2^(L−2)+1+1_{L even}. Inter-group gaps alternate between sizes 2 and 1 (in addition to the initial gap 1). An internal split at suffix length j appears once per legal prefix, so its multiplicity summed over suffix lengths L=j,…,K−1 is F_(K−j+2)−1. The collision G_2=G_3=3 yields the stated length-two count by the Fibonacci recurrence, also zero at K=2 where neither split appears. Gap size 2 gives floor(K/2) one-zero runs and the other nonempty runs come from G_j−1. All listed run counts diverge for fixed j or length, and every finite run occurs in a sufficiently long dyadic prefix ending with a one. Of F_(K+2)−1 total gaps, ceil(K/2) are size one; subtracting them gives the correct normalization. Binet asymptotics yield the stated masses, which sum to one via the geometric series. The scope is dyadic only. The recorded checks are finite; the uploaded verifier was not executed.
